name: Queen of Elfland
text: Every 3rd End of Turn: destroy units behind this, or this if none. Other Fairies share the destroyed units' stats.
golden_text: Every 3rd End of Turn: destroy units behind this, or this if none. Other Fairies share double the destroyed units' stats.
details: Teind counts End of Turns since this was played and resets after 3. Shares base stats and permanent buffs evenly; spare points go in board order.
